candidates.title: Metro commuter-labelled service receives new platform doors
candidates.search_snippet: The Metro/MRT Red Line, sometimes called commuter rail, received new platform doors.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic transport release. The service is the Metro/MRT Red Line, a grade-separated urban rapid-transit system. The source uses commuter rail as an informal passenger label, but the Candidate action installs platform doors on the explicitly identified Metro system.

contract_notes: The commuter label does not exclude a Candidate when authoritative content independently establishes Metro/MRT mode.
